r: Wow! This is extremely helpful in getting my Dog's declared filed down, easy and comfortable to hold providing an extreme ease of use! Has extra pads as well! Definitely recommend this!

If your dog/cat is freaked out by nail clippers or electric nail grinders this is a great option to try out. This is very easy to use and I would suggest slowly introducing them if they have known feet issues and try a swipe or two followed up by treats and praises. This will definitely take more time on your part, it's not a quick snip or a few seconds of electric grinding so just be prepared for that. One thing I wish was that the sanding circle size was just a bit bigger. It works fine for cat size but I have a 50 pound dog and his nails are a lot bigger and you can only do tiny swipes with the size of the sanding circle.
Works well, must be patient though.
Works as well as designed. Still had to work with my dog using it. But I truly believe I had far better luck with this tool then an electric one
Slower than a nail file, but gentler for skittish dogs

My dog has to be held down when we trim her nails. Using clippers she does eventually calm down, but when trying the electric Dremel type she flails around until she hurts us or herself trying to get loose so we gave up on that.

Even after she calms down after clippers, her nails still have sharp edges so we try and file them. Sometimes we have success, sometimes we do not. Using this instead of the file AFTER using the clippers gives us a much calmer pooch. She still doesn't like it, but tolerates it. It does take longer than the file because of how much smoother the "sandpaper" is over a nail file.
